fonts.display: 'SF Pro Display', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'SF Pro Text', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Apple Blue
palette.role: Primary CTA fill — the single saturated button on the page (Comprar, Learn more). Vivid mid-blue that reads as a switch-on moment against matte neutrals

palette.name: Link Blue
palette.role: Inline text links, footnote references, and underlined link borders. Slightly deeper and cooler than the CTA blue so links and buttons read as distinct actions

palette.name: Signal Green
palette.role: Accent stroke for positive health/sleep metric visualizations and decorative data highlights on product UI

palette.name: Ember Orange
palette.role: Orange outline accent for tags, dividers, and focused UI edges

palette.name: Iris Violet
palette.role: Tertiary accent for multicolor data rings, decorative product UI, and illustration strokes

palette.name: Deep Teal
palette.role: Quaternary accent completing the Apple Watch activity ring palette

palette.name: Space Black
palette.role: Primary text, heading fills, icon strokes, and card borders. Apple's near-black — softer than #000, reads warm against white

palette.name: Sterling
palette.role: Secondary/muted text, nav borders, list dividers, and subdued UI labels

palette.name: Graphite
palette.role: Nav border-bottom, link muted state, and mid-contrast UI text

palette.name: Slate
palette.role: Nav-specific dark text and borders in the top utility bar

palette.name: Smoke
palette.role: Disabled or de-emphasized button/link background fill

palette.name: Pebble
palette.role: Hairline borders, inactive dividers, and subdued list separators

palette.name: Concrete
palette.role: Light surface tone for secondary buttons and list-item fills sitting on white

palette.name: Fog
palette.role: Page canvas and section background — the dominant pale-gray that separates content bands from pure white card surfaces

palette.name: Pure White
palette.role: Card surfaces, button text on dark fills, nav backgrounds, and badge interiors

palette.name: Absolute
palette.role: True black for hero image overlays, icon fills, and high-contrast heading strokes
